Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a display device coupled to a set-top terminal, wherein the filtered EPG information is displayed in real-time as the subscriber accesses the EPG__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __by determining which channels the subscriber is authorized to receive based on the subscriber's service tier__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber __before the EPG information is presented to the subscriber__.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __in response to a request from the set-top terminal__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __that is stored locally on the set-top terminal__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information __received from the EPG provider at the set-top terminal__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information __for each program entry in the EPG information__; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __prior to storing the EPG information in memory__.

Claim 6 (Original): The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider __via a tuner module__; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider, __wherein the filtering is performed by a processor within the machine to remove programs not authorized for the subscriber before the EPG information is displayed__.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a display coupled to the machine in an on-screen menu format__.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __by accessing authorization information stored on the machine__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on a comparison of channel identifiers in the EPG information against the authorization information__.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __via a secure communication channel__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __and storing the list in non-volatile memory on the machine__.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information __from a buffer in the machine__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information __for each program listing in the EPG information__; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __and preventing the removed EPG information from being stored or displayed__.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information __on a display device, wherein the display module receives the filtered EPG information from the filter module and formats the filtered EPG information for presentation to the subscriber in real-time__.
